name: neuroloom
description: Claude Code remembers across sessions. Automatic observation capture stores every decision and context shift, searchable in every future session — scoped to a dedicated per-project key set up with /neuroloom:init. A key configured here globally can be offered as a one-time starting point during setup, but it never captures on a project's behalf by itself.

api_key.title: API Key (optional seed)
api_key.description: Optional. A default Neuroloom API key /neuroloom:init can offer to copy into a new project as a starting point — never used directly to route any project's memory capture. Get one at https://app.neuroloom.dev/api-keys
